## **Agenda**:

**Updates on:**

*1. Exit Theory podcast (soon to be voting)*

*2. New-Futures updated proposal and plan*

*3. Chico crypto strategy and plan*

*4. Geode - agency led NFT project*

*5. Community Film - next steps and interviews*

**New discussions:**

*6. RMRK - bringing Substrate native NFTs to Edgeware (https://rmrk.app)

*7. People vs Extinction - new NFT project in development (https://peoplevextinction.com/ feat https://www.zooportraits.com/)

## Call notes: 

- Edgeware has three paths to implementing on-chain and off-chain NFTs logic:
- Solidity based smart contracts
- Enables developers to utilise existing smart contracts
- Can port over audited code - for example Zien's ETH mainnet code and New-Futures to use Zora's code.  
- Can pass across EVM Bridge and so operate on ETH. 
- Ink based smart contracts
- Can be compliled down to WASM and coded in Rust which unlocks a greater pool of developers 
- With Alliance Block partnership and Geode work we now have ERC721 / 1155 standards on the chain.
- Can pass across EVM Bridge and so operate on ETH.
